widgets_values:
The single small orange robot in <Picture 1> is the only character. Preserve its rounded rectangular orange head, two glossy black eyes, black ear pieces, short antenna, claw hands and orange feet.

One continuous five-second product shot. The robot stands on a pale blue tabletop, gently turns its head toward the camera and raises one claw hand in a friendly wave. Its whole body stays visible. Soft warm studio lighting, stable camera, subtle natural movement. No extra robots, no text, no cuts.

Audio: quiet room ambience and a soft mechanical servo whirr. No speech or music.

nodes.title: READ ME
widgets_values:
## Orange Robot Demo

Copy `lorapilot_orange_robot_v1.safetensors` into `ComfyUI/models/refmods/`, then click **Refresh RefMods** in node 1. This example uses one reference, `<Picture 1>`, from the included `reference.png`. No training is required.

[Download the example and setup guide](https://github.com/vavo/minimax-h3-refmod-pilot/tree/main/examples/orange-robot)

[![LoRA Pilot: Train. Create. Repeat.](https://lorapilot.com/og-lora-pilot-studio.png)](https://lorapilot.com/)

**Made with [LoRA Pilot](https://lorapilot.com/) · Your GPU. Your tools. Your workspace.**

### Three steps
1. Choose your character RefMods. **+ Add RefMod** adds a slot; **Refresh RefMods** reloads the list; **RefMod library** opens the browser. Leave unused slots at `(none)`. Start with strength 1 and copies 1.
2. Write the scene and audio, choose size and seconds, then Run.
3. Your video appears in **OUTPUT** and saves under `output/video/RefModPilot*`.

### Size and duration
**Preset:** aspect ratio + megapixels. Start at 0.4 MP. **Custom size:** enables width/height instead; dimensions round to multiples of 32.

**Duration:** 5–15 seconds, rounded up to H3's 24 fps frame grid. 5s → 124 frames; 10s → 243; 15s → 362.

### Character labels
Match `<Picture n>` / `<Video n>` tags to your files. Slot numbers may differ from reference numbers. Open the Scene subgraph to inspect **Reference map** after encoding.

### Advanced / setup
Keep loader defaults unless needed. Open the Scene subgraph for models, sampler and memory settings. More references increase memory and time. RefMod creation does not train model weights.

Requires current ComfyUI, ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3Mod, KJNodes and separate model weights. [Installation and workflow guide](https://github.com/vavo/minimax-h3-refmod-pilot).
